Settings.Viewers.Intro: What the viewers read, and how much detail the 3D views load.
Settings.Viewers.RedkitProps: Read them from REDkit's source files when REDkit has one

Higher is sharper close up but slower to load, and a scene with many actors uses much more memory. Medium suits most. Viewers open already keep what they've read; it applies to those opened next.
